text:
Type: slim aluminum poster frame
Use: displaying a poster, print or photo on a wall; living room, home office, hallway, bedroom
Style: minimalist, modern, industrial
Materials: thin aluminum-colored metal frame, clear front, white backing
Colors: light silver grey, white
Shape: tall portrait rectangle with a very narrow flat profile, edge-to-edge display area, large yet visually light, flush to the wall
Feel: clean, cool, crisp, gallery-like
Goes with: white or grey walls, concrete, steel and glass, graphic prints; minimalist, modern or industrial rooms
